c74object.name: el.rtrig~
c74object.digest: Random click and impulse trigger generator
c74object.description:
el.rtrig~ randomly generates audio-rate clicks or impulse triggers. On every sample tick, a probability check is performed based on the specified odds; when triggered, the object outputs a single-sample impulse whose amplitude is chosen randomly between the specified minimum and maximum bounds. Between triggers, the output remains 0.0. The trigger frequency can be defined either as a per-sample probability (odds) or as an average event rate per second (density).
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Control message inlet (min, max, odds, density, mute). Signal connections are ignored.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Random trigger impulse output. Emits impulses with random amplitudes between min and max when triggered, and 0.0 at all other times.

inlet.description: Receives configuration messages (min, max, odds, density, mute). Signal connections to this inlet are ignored.

outlet.description: Outputs single-sample impulses with amplitudes chosen randomly between the minimum and maximum boundaries.

objarg.name: minimum-amplitude
objarg.description: Required. The lower amplitude limit for generated click impulses (try 0.0 to start).

objarg.name: maximum-amplitude
objarg.description: Required. The upper amplitude limit for generated click impulses (try 1.0 to start).

objarg.name: odds
objarg.description: Required. The probability per sample that a click impulse will be generated (range: 0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: density
method.digest: Set average click density per second
method.description: Sets the average number of trigger impulses to generate per second. Automatically calculates the required per-sample probability based on the current audio sampling rate.

method.name: max
method.description: Sets the upper amplitude limit for generated click impulses.

method.name: min
method.description: Sets the lower amplitude limit for generated click impulses.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), active random trigger generation resumes.

method.name: odds
method.description: Sets the probability that an impulse will be generated on any given audio sample (clamped between 0.0 and 1.0).

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is ignored by the perform routine.
